title: Agent
description: agent.yaml in agents/<code>/: a role with fixed duties, its own skills, the resources it binds and the directories that stay on each person's computer. The role's instructions are in the entry file (AGENT.md); the metadata is in meta.yaml.

id.description: The agent's code. It equals the name of its directory.

entry.description: The file with the role's instructions, for the AI.

skills.description: The agent's own skills: names of directories under skills/, each with a SKILL.md.

binds.description: Codes of resources of the repository the agent works with; they are installed along with it.

mcp.description: Codes of the MCP servers the agent depends on.

local.description: Directories that stay on each person's computer, such as memory/: an update does not overwrite them and they do not count towards the content digest.
